first_3_seconds: Tom leans out the window of a white 65 Mustang, then a greasy hand flips three red toggle switches (FP, FAN, ACC) and turns a key with an 8-ball keychain
spoken_or_text_hook: No words until the end; after the tach jumps and the side exhaust barks he asks "Better?"
why_it_went_viral: The start-up ritual (toggles, key, tach needle, exhaust tip, then the whole car) builds anticipation for a sound payoff in 18 seconds with zero talking. 68x the account median but only 0.28 percent shares, so it won on rewatches and likes, not sends.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Hot rod and V8 guys to the buddy who loves a loud small block; mostly watched, rarely sent
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Hand-held sequence of the start-up ritual in close-ups (switch, key, gauge, tailpipe), then one wide shot of the truck running, one word at the end.

first_3_seconds: Tom stands on grass in front of the white Mustang holding a big polished stainless exhaust tip and starts talking straight to camera
spoken_or_text_hook: What's up? My name is Tom and I own Speedy's Equipment, the only provider of these super sexy NASCAR style boom tube exhaust tips.
why_it_went_viral: A product pitch that pays off with the sound: 12 seconds of talking, then he walks to the car and the rest is the exhaust note. Odd shiny object plus "sound like this" proof made an ad travel (31x median, 26.7k saves from shoppers).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Guys building a car to the friend who is picking exhaust; saved more than shared
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Hold the part in your hands, say what it is in two sentences, then cut to the truck doing the thing the part is for.

first_3_seconds: Side view from the passenger seat of an OBS Chevy cab, Tom already rowing a manual shifter with a cornfield blurring past
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech and no text; engine noise and gear changes only
why_it_went_viral: Eight seconds of a pull through the gears with his reaction at the end (looks at camera, then yells). Pure sound and feel, loops easily, 20x median on a 0.53 percent share rate.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Manual truck guys to the buddy who misses his stick shift truck
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Phone clamped on the passenger side pointed at the driver, one pull through the gears, no talking, end on your face.

first_3_seconds: Same passenger-side angle in the Mustang, hand already on the shifter in a patch of sunlight, harness on, fields going by
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech and no text; caption is "Granny shifting on this fine Thursday"
why_it_went_viral: Nine seconds of relaxed shifting with a good exhaust note; it is a mood clip that loops. 16x median, modest 0.38 percent shares, so reach came from replays.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Stick shift people to each other, low intent
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Fixed cab cam on the shifter hand and the driver, one calm run through the gears, nothing said.

first_3_seconds: Extreme close-up of a tattooed forearm rotating the polished boom tube so the welds and outlets flash in the sun
spoken_or_text_hook: Shoei! Look at those TIG welds! (as transcribed; first word is an exclamation)
why_it_went_viral: Shiny-object close-up as the hook, then a fast restock pitch with scarcity ("only place that sells these"). Sales post that still did 16x median, but one of the weakest share rates of his set at 0.14 percent; people watched and saved, nobody sent it.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Buyers save it for themselves
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Open on a tight moving close-up of the part before your face ever appears, then 20 seconds of what it is.

first_3_seconds: Tom yells from the driver window inside the garage, camera whips down the rusty blue door with NOISE COMPLAINT lettered on it as the car rolls out
spoken_or_text_hook: No clear words (a shout from the window); the name painted on the car is the only text
why_it_went_viral: Five-second milestone clip: a known project car moves under its own power for the first time. Short enough to loop several times; followers who knew the build carried it (0.12 percent shares, only 85 comments).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Existing followers; little outside sharing
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: A five second clip of the first time the build does something new (fires, rolls, drives out), shot from outside, no setup.

first_3_seconds: A guy in a striped beanie and Dr Pepper shirt kneels at the side of a car running a polisher on the paint; Snapchat-style caption bar across the middle
spoken_or_text_hook: On-screen text: "TF is my detailer doing?"
why_it_went_viral: Caught-on-camera gag: the detailer drifts off the panel, the spinning polisher ends up on his own leg and he reacts out loud. It reads like a candid of a coworker being a goof, which is why it has 6.36 percent shares, more than six times the next best post on the account, on only 12x median views.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Anyone who works in a shop to the coworker who does dumb stuff: "this is you"
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Caption bar that blames an unseen helper or "the new guy" over a clip of yourself doing the job wrong, phone propped as if someone caught you.

first_3_seconds: Tom close to camera in a dirty shop shirt asking a question, then a cut to the rear quarter of the blue Mustang with "#1: NOISE COMPLAINT" on screen
spoken_or_text_hook: Which one of my currently running vehicles do you think sounds the best?
why_it_went_viral: A numbered sound-off: one question, then each vehicle cold starts in turn with a label, so viewers stay to hear all of them and vote. Highest comment count in his set (1,862) because the format asks for a pick.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Car guys to a buddy to argue over which one wins
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Ask one "which is best" question to camera, then numbered clips of each truck or engine sound, answer held for the caption.

first_3_seconds: Empty two-lane road shot from the shoulder; a small white car appears far off and grows fast
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech and no text; just the car approaching and the fly-by sound
why_it_went_viral: Seven-second fly-by: quiet road, then the Mustang rips past the camera. Anticipation plus the pass loops well (10.7x median), low sends at 0.22 percent.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Mustang and V8 fans, mostly likes
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Phone on the ground at the road edge, drive past it once, keep the whole approach in the clip.

first_3_seconds: Wide shot of a rusty patina 60s Mustang sitting in the rain, then a cut to a Honda badge in the grille and a red DOHC VTEC valve cover under the hood
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech; the reveal is the Honda H badge and the VTEC engine in a Mustang
why_it_went_viral: The car is the hook: a rat-rod Mustang with a turbo Honda engine is a "wait, what" build that splits Ford and Honda people. Eight seconds of quick detail cuts; best share rate of his non-skit posts at 0.99 percent.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Ford guys to Honda guys and back, as a dare or a laugh
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Eight seconds of quick detail cuts on the one thing about the truck people would not expect, wide shot first, the surprise by second two.

first_3_seconds: Dave outside in the lot points left at a white GMC, then swings his arm right toward a red GMC in the bay; camera follows his arm
spoken_or_text_hook: This beautiful truck and that beautiful truck have the exact same problem, and that one cost 10 times more to fix than that one, and I'm gonna tell you why.
why_it_went_viral: Two matching trucks, same mistake (DEF in the fuel tank), one bill ten times the other, with the physical proof (crystals, torn-down pump) and one rule: do not turn the key. Money stakes plus a mistake any diesel owner can make at the pump; 36x median, 24.7k shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Diesel owners to family, employees and buddies who drive diesels: "if you ever do this, do not start it"
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Point at two things that look the same, state the cost gap in the first sentence, show the evidence, end on one rule.

first_3_seconds: Dave leaning on the fender of a Ram 2500 with the hood up, talking, then the camera pans across the truck and the Cummins badge
spoken_or_text_hook: Never heard this problem. This is gonna be a new one for me. Cummins that just free spins.
why_it_went_viral: A veteran admits he is stumped, lets you hear the engine crank, lists what has been ruled out, then asks everyone to guess before teardown. 3,704 comments on 0.09 percent shares: a comment-driven mystery, it spread on arguments not sends.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Cummins owners and techs comment their diagnosis; few send it
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: State a problem you have not solved, play the sound, list what you already checked, ask for guesses and promise the answer.

first_3_seconds: Full-screen macro of white frost-like crystals, camera pulling back slowly to show they fill a black pan
spoken_or_text_hook: Isn't this the most beautiful thing you've ever seen?
why_it_went_viral: A strange, pretty texture you cannot identify, then the reveal that it is DEF left sitting three weeks, then he breaks it with his hand to show it is rock hard. Visual curiosity plus anger at emissions systems drove 54.6k shares (1.88 percent).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Diesel owners to every other diesel owner, and to the guy who defends DEF
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Open on a close-up of something from the shop nobody can identify, name it at second six, then touch or break it on camera.

first_3_seconds: Dave leaning over a front end talking to camera with a tech beside him; no visual change for the first 30 seconds
spoken_or_text_hook: I want to show you something, especially because it's summertime and it's getting hot.
why_it_went_viral: A seasonal problem everyone has (AC not cold) with a free check anyone can do: a radiator and condenser packed with debris. Highest saves in his set (84.5k) and 66.9k shares at 2.39 percent, because it is useful to people who do not turn wrenches and it posted July 1.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Truck owners to a spouse, parent or buddy whose AC is weak; techs to other techs
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Name a seasonal complaint, say what other shops get wrong, then show the simple thing to look at yourself.

first_3_seconds: A young tech in ear protection sets a bare 7.3 block on a stand, then close-ups of gloved hands working
spoken_or_text_hook: No speech; a silent build montage (caption: "7.3 Ford Power Stroke Engine Build with Bob the Builder")
why_it_went_viral: Nearly two minutes of clean hands-on assembly of a 7.3 Power Stroke, piece by piece, with no talking. Satisfying process footage holds watch time (19x median) but nobody sends it (0.11 percent).
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: 7.3 fans watch to the end; little sharing
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Silent time-ordered montage of one job from bare part to finished, tight shots of hands, no voice.

first_3_seconds: Dave leaning on an engine talking to camera, then a cut to a selfie clip of a mom and dad, then their 17-year-old with his 7.3 on a stand
spoken_or_text_hook: Apparently, the rumors are there's some young man that's trying to do a 7.3 for himself in a truck.
why_it_went_viral: A feel-good story about a 17-year-old rebuilding his first engine, stitched from the family's own video, ending with Dave asking the audience whether he should help. 9,042 comments, the most in his set, but only 827 shares: people voted in the comments.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Viewers comment and tag; rarely sent
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: React to a clip or message a follower sent you, say why it got to you, and ask the audience what you should do about it.

first_3_seconds: Dave standing in the shop with a tech beside him holding a tablet scan tool; cut to the tool's screen
spoken_or_text_hook: Mucar makes a really good scan tool.
why_it_went_viral: Sponsored scan tool demo with a discount code. 2.0M views against 24.3k likes and 0.04 percent shares does not look like organic spread; possibly promoted, but unclear. Do not read the view count as proof the format works.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Nobody, in practice
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Nothing to borrow as a viral shape; if a tool is shown, show it finding a real fault on a real truck.

first_3_seconds: Dave close to camera holding up fingers and counting, then a cut to techs loading plates at a catered lunch table
spoken_or_text_hook: There's five things I do in my shop to make my team's life more exciting and comfortable here in the shop.
why_it_went_viral: A boss listing concrete perks (payday lunch, prize wheel, snacks, chiropractor, bidets) with footage of each and a funny last item. People send it at their own boss or share it as "this is how you run a shop": 32.5k shares, 2.32 percent, 205k likes on 1.4M views.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: Techs to coworkers and bosses: "must be nice"; shop owners to each other
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Count a short list on your fingers to camera, one concrete item per cut, save the oddest one for last.

first_3_seconds: Dave leaning over the same Ram's engine bay with a tech behind him, talking to camera
spoken_or_text_hook: We found the problem because of you guys. Isn't that a wonderful thing?
why_it_went_viral: The answer video to the free-spinning Cummins mystery: he credits commenters who called a stuck throttle plate, then the truck starts on camera. Payoff for people who guessed (12x median), smaller than the question video, 0.21 percent shares.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: People who commented on part one; Cummins owners save the fix
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Part two that opens by crediting the audience's answer, shows the fix, and ends on the engine starting.

first_3_seconds: Dave close to camera in the machine shop, a news headline card about a GM recall pops up at second two
spoken_or_text_hook: This motor has cost GM over $1 billion.
why_it_went_viral: Big-number hook on a current recall, then he holds the actual crank and bearing and explains the cause with measurements and an ocean-wave analogy. News timing and a brand fight drove 2,019 comments; 0.44 percent shares over 111 seconds.
who_shares_it_and_to_whom: GM owners to other GM owners; Ford and Ram guys to the GM buddy as a jab
shape_jacob_can_borrow_alone: Open with one dollar figure about a known problem, hold the failed part in your hand, explain the cause with one everyday comparison.
